sloka: ततो रामो महातेजा रावणेन कृतव्रणम् ।दृष्ट्वा प्लवगशार्दूलं कोपस्य वशमेयिवान् ।। ६.५९.१३७ ।।।।
transliteration: tato rāmo mahātejā rāvaṇena kṛtavraṇam ।dṛṣṭvā plavagaśārdūlaṁ kopasya vaśameyivān ।। 6.59.137 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the wounds caused by Ravana to Hanuman, the tiger among monkeys, possibly Rama was seized with anger.
